minimal_change: One shared key normalization in taxonomy, consumed by detector._types aggregate guard. Projection resolves final member, applies only finite immediate-parent contextual pair rules, and never classifies all receiver tokens. Structured carries only direct parent role without crossing arrays/decode boundaries or generic inherited PII. No expression evaluator or taxonomy-category expansion required.
regression_assertions: APIKey/IPAddress keep original specific labels; HTTPAuthorization/HTTPHeaders gain expected finite labels.
APIKeyCount/APIKEYCount/IPAddressCount/HTTPHeadersCount produce no sensitive/coarse labels; test detect_snapshot as well as _matches.
user.ID/user.Name/user.get("ID") receive only the bounded intended type; cache.ID/repo.Name remain unknown.
APIKey.id/password.name give no credential; password.user.id gives only QID.user_identifier; user.unknown_field remains queued.
JSON user:{id:7} may gain QID on the exact leaf; repo:{id:7} and user:{unmapped:7} stay unresolved; null/boolean/empty/masked values must not gain candidates.
JSON user:{account:{id:7}} must follow only the explicit current parent rule; arrays and encoded strings must not silently inherit unrelated parent hints.
Known candidate plus an unknown sibling retains unknown_nodes and a full nonempty-cell review queue.
If redactor normalization is in scope, synthetic shape-free values under APIKey are masked; key names/metadata and semantic fingerprints keep their established representation.
